subject: Invoice submission path & compact template — Acme Supplies onboarding

Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery options

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding heads-up. We're starting activation for Redwood next week and want to confirm your preferred invoice intake flow so our AP team can align. A few questions up front:

- Do you require invoices submitted through a portal (preferred) or is SMTP/email acceptable as the primary channel?
- If email fallback is allowed, what subject format or token do you need to tie to POs?
- Any mandatory fields we must include (supplier tax ID, remit address, PO number format, line-level PO vs header-level)?
- Can we send invoices with multiple PO numbers on a single PDF/CSV, or should we split them?

I've attached a small sample CSV with two invoice lines (no sensitive data) to illustrate our current layout. Also attaching our standard vendor setup form in case you want it filled and returned.

Attachments: [Attachment: Acme_sample_invoice.csv (CSV, 3 KB)], [Attachment: Acme_vendor_onboard_form.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Appreciate any mapping guidance or a short checklist so we can avoid rework.

Best,
Emma Cho

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice delivery options

Emma — thanks for sending this over and for the attachments. Short answer: portal preferred for production (better idempotency and PO matching); email can be used temporarily during onboarding with strict subject rules.

Quick requests so our ops team can ingest your files without manual fixes:
- Preferred: submit via our vendor portal (we will send the invite link and onboarding token once the vendor form is processed).
- Fallback (email): please prefix subject with "ACME-INV: <PO#>" (example: "ACME-INV: PO-123456"). If you must include multiple POs in one email, put one PO in the subject and list additional POs in the first line of the body separated by commas.
- Mandatory fields in CSV/PDF: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, total_amount, supplier_tax_id, remit_address.
- Line-level multi-PO support: allowed, but each row must include a PO_number column. If you put multiple POs on a single PDF attachment without per-line PO metadata, we will need to split it which delays payment.

I've attached our minimal vendor onboarding form (see Procure->Onboard section). Can you confirm you will update the sample CSV to include a supplier_tax_id and the PO_number column?

Thanks — I will loop in Kimberly for final field validation and Vanessa for the portal invite.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the update — left a few technical notes below that are important for mapping and avoiding exceptions.

Required fields (CSV headers we expect):
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (string; must match PO format sent from our PR system, case-insensitive)
- line_item_description
- qty (integer)
- unit_price (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal)
- line_total (decimal)
- supplier_tax_id (string)
- remit_address (string)

Field rules:
- Currency must be USD unless otherwise noted in a header column currency=EUR.
- If multiple POs are present on one invoice, each row must include its respective po_number. Aggregated PDF invoices without per-line PO mapping will be rejected.
- PDF invoices are accepted but CSV gives faster automated processing. We are able to accept CSV uploads in the portal now.

Email fallback rules:
- Subject token format: "ACME-INV: <primary_PO>". If you need to include extra POs, list them in the email body on the first line as: "Additional POs: PO-22222, PO-33333".
- Only one invoice PDF per email (if sending PDF). If sending multiple PDFs, please send separate emails.
- Bccs are ignored by our parser.

Operational notes:
- Portal invites: Vanessa will send the vendor portal invite after we receive the signed vendor form and tax details.
- SLA: invoices submitted through portal => 30-day payment SLA from invoice_date. Email fallback => processing may be delayed by 3–5 business days while we reconcile.

Link to our onboarding template: https://drive.google.com/example/acme-onboard-template

Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
